entries.title: SynthPAI
entries.testing_scope: Curate every human_evaluated attribute entry in the authors merged evaluation release. Retain the first ranked grade in {0, 0.5, 1}; an empty grade list remains null. These are attribute-level measurements of joint profile-generation calls, not independent model calls. Match each generation to its original prediction row by the exact model label and full answer, then recover its recorded prompt by the logged row number. Preserve the actual model-specific shortened comment inputs and ordered requested attributes. System prompts and configuration text come from the original logs; these are recorded prompt objects, not complete provider wire requests. One Llama-2-13B source row has an inconsistent username; its unique full answer and comment subset identify the merged profile, while both original names remain in the trace. All profiles are synthetic. Unscored attributes and separate anonymization/Claude-2.1 experiments are outside the merged grading population and remain only in captured source files. Do not infer grades from guesses or rerun matching, human adjudication, model-based education mapping, or model inference.
entries.description: SynthPAI: personal-attribute inference from synthetic Reddit profiles. 294 synthetic author profiles (7823 comments); 18 LLMs infer up to 8 personal attributes (age, sex, location, birthplace, education, occupation, income, relationship status) from comment history. Each model gives a ranked guess list per attribute, graded 0/0.5/1 against human-curated ground truth.
